extName.message: Manta Action Kit - AI Developer Toolkit & Agent Browser Bridge
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome store and toolbar.

extDescription.message: Secure access to your authenticated APIs for Claude Code & Codex. Record business flows via a sandbox proxy — cookies stay private.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome store.

notifyRecordDoneTitle.description: System notification title when a recording session is saved.

notifyRecordDoneMessage.description: System notification body with the captured call count.

notifyConfirmTitle.description: System notification title when a sandbox call awaits confirmation.

notifyConfirmMessage.description: System notification body with the request method and target host.

notifyGifFailedTitle.description: System notification title when a GIF recording could not be encoded or saved.

notifyGifFailedMessage.message: The recording could not be encoded as a GIF
notifyGifFailedMessage.description: System notification body for a failed GIF recording.

notifyGifTimeLimitTitle.message: GIF recording reached the time limit
notifyGifTimeLimitTitle.description: System notification title when a GIF recording auto-stopped at the maximum duration.

notifyGifTimeLimitMessage.message: The recording was saved automatically and is ready in the preview tab
notifyGifTimeLimitMessage.description: System notification body when a GIF recording auto-stops at the maximum duration.

notifyScreenshotFailedTitle.description: System notification title when a screenshot could not be captured (shown because the popup already closed itself).

notifyScreenshotConflictMessage.message: Close DevTools on this tab and try again
notifyScreenshotConflictMessage.description: System notification body when another debugger (usually DevTools) is attached to the tab.

notifyScreenshotProtectedMessage.message: Chrome protects this page, so it cannot be captured (e.g. the Web Store)
notifyScreenshotProtectedMessage.description: System notification body when Chrome refuses to attach the debugger to a protected page (screenshot:protected-page).

notifyScreenshotFailedMessage.message: This page could not be captured as a screenshot
notifyScreenshotFailedMessage.description: System notification body for a generic screenshot failure.

notifyGifConfirmTitle.description: System notification title when an agent-requested tab recording awaits confirmation.

notifyGifConfirmMessage.message: An agent wants to record $HOST$ — click Allow in the popup window
notifyGifConfirmMessage.description: System notification body with the target host of an agent-requested tab recording.

notifyRelevanceFailedTitle.description: System notification title when the laya relevance analysis for a recording could not run.

notifyRelevanceFailedMessage.message: The local model could not analyze this recording — open the model settings and try again later
notifyRelevanceFailedMessage.description: System notification body for a failed relevance analysis.
